Product Features

  • Adjustable Headboard: The padded headboard is filled with high-density, thicker sponge, so you can relax comfortably when leaning against it. The height of the headboard is adjustable, and the adjustable height range is about 12cm difference.People of different heights can find the best comfort point by adjusting the height of the headboard.
  • Charging station with sockets & USB ports: One of the most practical features is the built-in socket at the head of the bed, which allows you to charge your mobile phone and tablet before going to bed. At the head of the bed, there are built-in USB/Type-C ports and European plugs.
  • Flexible and spacious storage: The 50 cm high headboard features a cabinet design with four generous compartments. For storing clothes, there are four drawers on wheels under the bed.
  • Well thought-out details: The slatted frames are made of 100% solid wood and metal offer both a high load-bearing capacity and a high level of sleeping comfort. The soft materials of the bed not only provide a comfortable feeling, but also effectively reduce damage from sharp corners and edges that you or your family would probably suffer in use.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 boxes and they can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.If you move the bed, please lift it instead of sanding it on the floor.***Please note that product colors may vary in different lighting conditions.****
